adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the PR updates `calendarReference` handling to support multiple calendar references (switching from `.find(...)` to `.filter(...)` and looping over all refs). However, the merge cleanup path under `if (newBookingId)` still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which only selects the first calendar reference. Given this PR now supports multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., collective/team destinations), this would delete only one old host’s calendar event and can leave orphaned events for the other references.
